post.title: Looking for a freelancer or agency to build a SaaS MVP
post.body:
I'm looking for a skilled freelancer or software development agency to build a SaaS web application from scratch.

Project requirements:

* Modern, responsive UI/UX
* User authentication and subscription payments
* Admin dashboard and backend APIs
* Scalable architecture and clean code

Budget: $20–$35/hour, depending on experience and expertise.

To apply, please share:

* Your portfolio and relevant projects
* Recommended tech stack
* Estimated timeline
* Hourly rate

I'm looking for someone reliable who can deliver quality work and potentially collaborate on future projects.

Comment below or DM me if you're interested!

analysis.summary: Looking for a freelancer or agency to build a SaaS web application from scratch with UI/UX, backend APIs, and authentication.

expect: mentions the MVP needs from the post: authentication, subscription payments, an admin dashboard
cites the subscription billing project (or the GitHub link) as the relevant work, with only one link
does not agree to the $20-35/hour budget in public (it is below the profile's minimum rate) and does not claim to be an agency
